overview.title: Welcome to Nova Market Console
overview.desc: Your central control tower to monitor daily seller performance and store activity.

kpis.title: Key Performance Indicators
kpis.desc: At-a-glance revenue, order volume, and active customer counts with real-time growth badges.

triage.title: Daily Priority Actions
triage.desc: Directly access urgent orders requiring fulfillment and critical low stock alerts.

chart.title: Sales Trajectory
chart.desc: Visualize revenue dynamics and order volume trends across customizable timeframes.

navigation.title: Primary Navigation
navigation.desc: Seamlessly switch between orders, catalog, stock management, and performance analytics.

orders.title: Order Processing
orders.desc: Track every customer order from confirmation and preparation to final delivery.

products.title: Product Catalog
products.desc: Manage SKU references, photos, pricing, and availability in just a few clicks.

inventory.title: Inventory Management
inventory.desc: Monitor stock alerts and make immediate inline quantity adjustments to prevent stockouts.

store.title: Multi-Store Switcher
store.desc: Switch between your storefronts and view online opening status immediately.

ordersView.title: Kanban Pipeline & Table Switcher
ordersView.desc: Toggle between the Kanban workflow board and dense tabular view for bulk triage.

ordersFilter.title: Search & Status Filters
ordersFilter.desc: Find any order instantly by number, customer name, or fulfillment status.

ordersContent.title: Operational Workflow
ordersContent.desc: Advance orders to the next stage in one click or click any card for full details.

productsAdd.title: Add New Product
productsAdd.desc: Create a new catalog item with images, SKU, category, pricing, and initial stock.

productsToggle.title: Visual Grid & Table Views
productsToggle.desc: Switch between visual product cards and a compact data table view.

productsCategories.title: Category Filtering
productsCategories.desc: Filter products by department for focused catalog updates.

inventoryRadar.title: Stock Health Radar
inventoryRadar.desc: Instantly see the balance between healthy stock, low-stock warnings, and out-of-stock items.

inventoryFilters.title: Urgency Filter Buttons
inventoryFilters.desc: Filter items needing immediate replenishment with one click.

inventorySteppers.title: Direct Inline Stock Adjustment
inventorySteppers.desc: Update inventory counts instantly using the +/- steppers without opening heavy modals.

analyticsPeriod.title: Timeframe Selector
analyticsPeriod.desc: Analyze revenue trends over 7 days, 30 days, or the last 12 months.

analyticsKpis.title: Commercial Metrics
analyticsKpis.desc: Track average order value, unique store visitors, and shopper conversion rate.

analyticsCharts.title: Sales Distribution
analyticsCharts.desc: Understand the contribution of each product category to total sales.

ordersStatusTabs.title: Order Status Tabs
ordersStatusTabs.desc: Filter by status (Pending, Preparing, Shipped, Delivered, Cancelled) for targeted processing of your work queue.

productsSearch.title: Catalog Search & Filter
productsSearch.desc: Instantly find any product by name, SKU or category. Combine search and category filters to pinpoint exactly what you need.

inventoryBulk.title: Bulk Stock Actions
inventoryBulk.desc: Select multiple products simultaneously to adjust quantities, export, or apply bulk restocking — ideal after a supplier delivery.

analyticsExport.title: Export & Financial Reports
analyticsExport.desc: Download your sales data in CSV or PDF for tax declarations or monthly performance reviews.

deliveriesKpis.title: Real-Time Logistics Dashboard
deliveriesKpis.desc: Four indicators summarize your delivery network: couriers in transit, parcels awaiting dispatch, deliveries today, and reported delays.

deliveriesFilters.title: Status Filters & GPS Control
deliveriesFilters.desc: Filter the map by delivery status and activate the 'Simulate movement' button to observe real-time GPS position updates of partner couriers.

deliveriesMap.title: Interactive Map — Greater Antananarivo
deliveriesMap.desc: Each marker represents a courier on the Antananarivo map. Click a marker to view order details and the planned itinerary.

deliveriesList.title: Synchronized Deliveries List
deliveriesList.desc: The list on the right is synchronized with the map: clicking a delivery automatically centers the map on the courier.

deliveriesSimulate.title: GPS Movement Simulation
deliveriesSimulate.desc: This demo mode updates courier positions every 3 seconds to simulate real GPS tracking. In production, this will be replaced by a live GPS data stream from your backend API.

customersKpis.title: Key CRM Metrics
customersKpis.desc: Three metrics summarize your customer base health: portfolio size, average basket per order, and total lifetime value (LTV) in Ariary.

customersSegments.title: Automatic Customer Segmentation
customersSegments.desc: Nova Market classifies buyers into 4 segments: All, VIP (spending > 1,000,000 Ar), Regular (5+ orders), and New. Use these filters to target your commercial actions.

customersSearch.title: Customer Search by Name or Email
customersSearch.desc: Instantly locate a buyer to view their order history, WhatsApp contact details, and loyalty level.

customersList.title: Customer Cards & Profile Details
customersList.desc: Click any card to open the detailed panel: complete order history, personal average basket, delivery cities, and direct contact actions (WhatsApp, email).

reviewsScore.title: Global Satisfaction Score
reviewsScore.desc: Your average rating out of 5 and positive satisfaction rate are visible here. This score directly influences your ranking in Nova Market searches and buyer trust.

reviewsFilters.title: Priority Review Filters
reviewsFilters.desc: Show only 'To reply' reviews to focus on customers waiting for a response. Replying within 24 hours improves your seller responsiveness index.

reviewsList.title: Verified Reviews Feed
reviewsList.desc: Each review shows the customer name, ordered product, detailed rating, and reply status. Unanswered reviews are flagged with an orange 'Pending' badge.

reviewsReply.title: Replying Professionally to Reviews
reviewsReply.desc: Click 'Reply' to open the response editor. Use quick reply templates (Thanks, Satisfaction, Support) to save time. Your response is publicly published on the product page.

storeHero.title: Store Visual Identity
storeHero.desc: The cover banner and logo are the first elements buyers see. Click the camera buttons to update your visuals. A complete profile with photo increases conversion rate by 40%.

storeVacation.title: Vacation Mode & Opening Status
storeVacation.desc: Activate Vacation Mode if you temporarily cannot ship. Customers will see an unavailability message and cannot order until reactivation. This protects your shipping delay score.

storeTabs.title: Store Configuration Sections
storeTabs.desc: Three tabs structure management: General Information (name, description, contact), Opening Hours (weekly schedule), and Policies & Delivery (return rules, delivery zones).

storeProfileForm.title: Profile Form & Social Links
storeProfileForm.desc: Fill in your store name, an engaging description, and contact details. Add your Facebook, Instagram, and website links to strengthen credibility with Malagasy buyers.

settingsQuickHub.title: Quick Access to Dedicated Pages
settingsQuickHub.desc: This hub groups the 8 sections with independent full pages. Click an icon to navigate directly to Store, Products, Inventory, Orders, Deliveries, Customers, Reviews, or Analytics.

settingsSidebar.title: Settings Category Navigation
settingsSidebar.desc: The sidebar organizes 29 business settings into 4 groups: General & Identity, Commerce & Finance, Operations & System, and Resources & Legal.

settingsAccount.title: Profile & Personal Preferences
settingsAccount.desc: Update your account information (name, email, phone, avatar), choose your theme (Light/Dark), change the portal language, and configure accessibility.

settingsPayments.title: Payout Accounts & Subscription
settingsPayments.desc: Manage your Mobile Money accounts (Telma MVola, Orange Money, Airtel Money) and bank accounts (BNI Madagascar) to receive weekly payouts.

settings.title: Interactive Guided Tours
settings.subtitle: Replay walkthroughs anytime to master every tool in your seller console

mainTour.title: Complete Welcome Tour
mainTour.desc: The essential guided walkthrough exploring the dashboard and main seller sections.

ordersTour.title: Order Management Tour
ordersTour.desc: Learn how to use the Kanban pipeline and advance orders efficiently.

productsTour.title: Product Catalog Tour
productsTour.desc: Discover how to add, edit, and organize catalog items.

inventoryTour.title: Inventory Control Tour
inventoryTour.desc: Optimize stock reserves and configure alert thresholds.

analyticsTour.title: Analytics & Performance Tour
analyticsTour.desc: Explore revenue charts and category breakdown metrics.

deliveriesTour.title: GPS Delivery Tracking Guide
deliveriesTour.desc: Learn to use the interactive map, status filters, and GPS movement simulation to manage your couriers.

customersTour.title: CRM & Customer Loyalty Guide
customersTour.desc: Master VIP/Regular/New segmentation and learn to view buyer profiles and their order histories.

reviewsTour.title: Reputation Management Guide
reviewsTour.desc: Learn to reply to reviews, use quick reply templates, and improve your seller satisfaction score.

storeTour.title: Store Configuration Guide
storeTour.desc: Configure your visual identity, opening hours, vacation mode, and return policies for your Nova Market storefront.

settingsTour.title: Complete Settings Hub Guide
settingsTour.desc: Navigate through 29 business settings organized in 4 groups: account, finances, operations, and legal resources.

aiAutomation.title: AI Assistant & Automations
aiAutomation.subtitle: Understand your business and prepare automated operations in one workspace.
aiAutomation.emptyHistory: Conversations will appear here when an AI service is connected.
aiAutomation.quotaUnavailable: Usage and renewal details are unavailable without server data.
aiAutomation.welcomeDescription: Ask about sales, products, inventory, or orders. Answers require a connection to the seller AI service.
aiAutomation.backendUnavailable: AI service unavailable: no answer will be simulated until the backend is connected.
aiAutomation.composerPlaceholder: Ask a question about your store…
aiAutomation.composerHint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line

prompt.sales: How are my sales performing this week?
prompt.description: Help me improve a product description.
prompt.cancelled: How can I reduce cancelled orders?

aiAutomation.proIntro: Pro supports simple rules once the automation service is available.
aiAutomation.freeIntro: Browse templates. Pro unlocks simple rules; Max adds supported advanced capabilities.
aiAutomation.templatesSubtitle: Examples of triggers and actions. They cannot run yet.
aiAutomation.historyBackendRequired: History will appear when the workflow engine is connected.
aiAutomation.builderUnavailable: The backend cannot save, test, or activate workflows yet. Form changes are not saved.

template.lowStockDetail: Notify the team when an item falls below its threshold.
template.newOrderDetail: Alert the seller when an order arrives.
template.unprocessedDetail: Remind about an order left pending beyond a set duration.
template.outOfStockDetail: Flag unavailable products and suggest replenishment.
template.reportDetail: Prepare a recurring report if the reporting service is available.
template.deliveryDetail: Alert the seller when a shipment exceeds its expected time.
template.optimizeDetail: Suggest product description improvements on request.
template.salesDetail: Notify the seller when a sales target is reached.
template.promotionDetail: Prepare a scheduled activation if promotions are supported.
template.restockDetail: Suggest replenishment using stock and sales pace.

deliveries.title: Delivery Tracking
deliveries.subtitle: Track your active deliveries in real-time across the Antananarivo metropolitan area
deliveries.bannerDesc: Positions and status updates arrive in real time. Delivery and notification history remain available through the API.
deliveries.realtimeConnectedDescription: The map receives live positions and status changes. Historical data remains available through the API.
deliveries.realtimeDisconnectedDescription: Initial state and history are loaded from the API. The map reconnects automatically to the tracking stream.
